--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
-- Hard guard: imported plugin models must never run as game scripts. if RunService:IsRunning() then return end
local pluginContext: Plugin? = plugin if pluginContext == nil then return end
local Root = script.Parent local PLUGIN_ICON = "rbxassetid://96262651806386"
local toolbar = pluginContext:CreateToolbar("Cursor Easy V2") local button = toolbar:CreateButton( "CursorEasyV2Toggle", "Open Cursor Easy V2", PLUGIN_ICON, "Easy V2" ) button.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true
local controller: any = nil local visibilityConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil local initializing = false local alive = true
local function reportFailure(stage: string, message: any) warn(string.format("[Cursor Easy V2] %s failed:\n%s", stage, tostring(message))) end
local function destroyController() if visibilityConnection then visibilityConnection:Disconnect() visibilityConnection = nil end
if controller then local activeController = controller controller = nil local ok, err = xpcall(function() activeController:Destroy() end, debug.traceback) if not ok then reportFailure("shutdown", err) end end
button:SetActive(false) end
local function initializeController(): boolean if RunService:IsRunning() then return false end if controller then return true end if initializing then return false end
initializing = true local builtController: any = nil local ok, err = xpcall(function() local EasyController = require(Root.Controllers.EasyController) builtController = EasyController.new(pluginContext) end, debug.traceback)
if not ok or not builtController then initializing = false reportFailure("bootstrap", err) return false end
if RunService:IsRunning() then initializing = false builtController:Destroy() return false end
controller = builtController visibilityConnection = controller:GetVisibilityChangedSignal():Connect(function(visible: boolean) button:SetActive(visible) end)
local startOk, startErr = xpcall(function() controller:Start() end, debug.traceback) if not startOk then reportFailure("startup", startErr) end
initializing = false return true end
button.Click:Connect(function() if RunService:IsRunning() or not initializeController() then return end
local ok, err = xpcall(function() controller:Toggle() end, debug.traceback) if not ok then reportFailure("toggle", err) end end)
-- Stop all plugin behavior as soon as Studio starts simulating. task.spawn(function() local wasRunning = RunService:IsRunning() while alive do local running = RunService:IsRunning() if running and (not wasRunning or controller ~= nil) then destroyController() end wasRunning = running task.wait(0.1) end end)
pluginContext.Unloading:Connect(function() alive = false destroyController() end)

--!strict
export type Task = RBXScriptConnection | Instance | (() -> ())
local Maid = {} Maid.__index = Maid
export type Maid = typeof(setmetatable({ _tasks = {} :: {Task}, }, Maid))
function Maid.new(): Maid return setmetatable({ _tasks = {}, }, Maid) end
function Maid.Give(self: Maid, task: Task): Task table.insert(self._tasks, task) return task end
function Maid.Cleanup(self: Maid) for index = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do local task = self._tasks[index] self._tasks[index] = nil
if typeof(task) == "RBXScriptConnection" then (task :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect() elseif typeof(task) == "Instance" then (task :: Instance):Destroy() else (task :: () -> ())() end end end
function Maid.Destroy(self: Maid) self:Cleanup() end
return Maid
